svg.text: PROPOSAL ONLY — same wall cells, source positions, collision footprints and door openings
A coherent 16-unit wall thickness; continuous right wall; joined corners, T-junctions and exposed ends.
Unified cap / face / base datum and consistent corner shadowing. Four-tile bay openings remain clear.
Door jambs and shallow sill dressing stay outside collision clearance. No garage footprint change proposed.
Diagram shows topology and assembly intent, not new environmental artwork or a runtime screenshot.
